verdict: A3 PROVED at n=5, both sides. No remaining gap of the kind route1 flagged.
theorem: For every singleton-normalized exact 5-player game, min_i Lmin_i = lambda = min_S f(S)/|S| and max_i Lmax_i = nu = max_S v(S)/|S|.

exact_cone_description.citation: Studeny & Kratochvil, Facets of the cone of exact games, MMOR 95 (2022) 35-80; catalogue front page, quoted verbatim in REPORT.txt section 1
exact_cone_description.form: v exact <=> v(empty)=0 and sum_S lambda_S v(S) <= r v(N) for every indecomposable min-semi-balanced system, all permutations

validation.minimal_balanced_implied: 1292/1292 (so nonempty core is entailed; no separate Bondareva-Shapley needed)

reduction.M_side: M=nu iff min over fractional covers w of sum_S w_S h(S) >= h(N), h(S)=nu|S|-v(S)>=0
reduction.mu_side: mu=lambda iff the same with f'(S)=f(S)-lambda|S|
finiteness: objective >=0 on a pointed polyhedron with recession cone the nonneg orthant, so the min is attained at a VERTEX; vertices have support <= n = 5
fixing the anchor coalition attaining nu (resp. lambda) makes everything linear in v
v(N)=1 is free by homogeneity; T=0 forces v==0 and A3 holds trivially

enumeration.self_contained: the 1142-class run includes the balanced vertices, so route1's P10 is not relied on
enumeration.solver: z3 exact rational, lazy cut generation; every call asserted to return sat or unsat (guarded rerun allverts2.log)

drop_the_cone.meaning: the encoding can express a failure; exactness is what forbids it

positive_controls.random_positive: 60/60 random exact 5-player games satisfy M=nu and mu=lambda

closes: paper5 Conjecture (one-coalition certificates at five players) becomes a theorem
the covering-vs-full-LP gap: the check quantifies over every cover vertex, not over nu-tight covering families
does_not_close: (*) / route1 O2 (f({j}) >= T/8 for the Lmax-starved player) does NOT follow formally from A3 -- it is a statement about a different functional; route1's expectation that O2 falls out of O1 should be re-examined, not assumed
anything at n>=6 (the M-side is false there)
the Studeny-Kratochvil facet theorem is used as a validated citation, not re-proved
